summary: Replaces the hardcoded $(source-control) glyph with a gitTool.statusBarIcon setting defaulting to multiple-windows, chosen because two other extensions in this pack already show $(git-branch). Verified through the stubbed host: unset, icon-only, bare name, $(name) form, blank string, and a custom tool label all render the expected text. tsc compiles clean; README row added; markdown checker reports no errors.

improvements.text: An unknown codicon name renders as a blank glyph with no warning, since the name is not validated against the codicon set.
improvements.recommendation: Left as is: the set changes with each VS Code release, so a bundled list would go stale; the setting description links the official codicon reference.

positives.text: statusBarIcon accepts both the bare codicon name and the $(name) form, and a blank value falls back to the default, so no setting value can produce an empty status bar item.

verdict.rationale: Small, well-contained change; no critical or high findings.
